cards.name: Lorthos, the Tidemaker
cards.oracleText: Whenever Lorthos attacks, you may pay {8}. If you do, tap up to eight target permanents. Those permanents don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps.

cards.name: Lorthos, Tentacled Terror
cards.oracleText:
Mono Eminence — As the game begins, if Lorthos is your commander and your deck's color identity is mono-blue, your starting hand size becomes 8. (You draw 8 cards and your maximum hand size is 8.)
Whenever Lorthos attacks, tap all permanents your opponent controls.
Partner (You can have two commanders if both have partner.)
